strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}欢迎来到彩虹百货！{SCROLL}彩虹百货各楼层的服务分别为：{NEWLINE}１楼……前台服务{CLEAR}２楼……训练家专柜{CLEAR}３楼……技能机专柜{CLEAR}４楼……礼品专柜{CLEAR}５楼……香水香草与树果专柜{CLEAR}６楼……休闲广场{SCROLL}您还可以浏览电梯旁的看板{NEWLINE}查看当前楼层的信息！
strings.en: Welcome! Welcome to the Celadon{NEWLINE}Department Store!{SCROLL}Here’s what we have on each floor:{NEWLINE}1F: Service Counter{CLEAR}2F: Trainer’s Market{CLEAR}3F: TM Shop{CLEAR}4F: Wiseman Gifts{CLEAR}5F: Perfume, Herbs & Berries{CLEAR}6F: Rooftop Atrium{SCROLL}You can also check the board by the{NEWLINE}elevator for each floor’s information!
strings.notes: The hack renamed 5F (US Battle Collection) to 香水香草与树果专柜 → Perfume, Herbs & Berries; other floor names follow the US.

strings.zh: 远在城都地区的满金市,{NEWLINE}有一家跟彩虹百货非常像的满金百货。{CLEAR}不知道那里的商品{CLEAR}跟这里有什么不一样呢？
strings.en: In Goldenrod City, far away in Johto,{NEWLINE}there’s the Goldenrod Department{CLEAR}Store, which is a lot like this one.{SCROLL}I wonder how their goods differ from{NEWLINE}the ones here?

strings.zh: 我还是头一回来这……{NEWLINE}这里实在太大了,{CLEAR}弄得我都要迷路了！
strings.en: This is my first time here.{NEWLINE}It’s so big...{CLEAR}I’m afraid I’ll get lost.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『哇,这里有这么多种商品啊,{NEWLINE}先去哪层好呢？{CLEAR}想去买精灵用品,{CLEAR}可是5楼的香水似乎也不错。
strings.en: Cynthia: Wow, there are so many kinds{NEWLINE}of goods here! Which floor should I go{CLEAR}to first?{SCROLL}I need Pokémon supplies, but the{NEWLINE}fifth-floor perfume looks lovely too.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『呀,{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}你也是来逛商店的吗？{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}希罗娜『什么？{NEWLINE}彩虹道馆的精灵被人抢走了？{CLEAR}这么说来,我来彩虹百货的路上{CLEAR}好像有看到一个黑衣人{CLEAR}抱着精灵横穿过马路。{CLEAR}具体是跑向哪里了呢……
strings.en: Cynthia: Oh, {VAR:0103:0}. Are you here{NEWLINE}shopping too?{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}Cynthia: What? Someone stole a Pokémon{NEWLINE}from the Celadon Gym?{SCROLL}Come to think of it, on my way to the{NEWLINE}department store, I think I saw{CLEAR}someone in black carrying a Pokémon{CLEAR}across the road.{SCROLL}Which way was he running, now...

strings.zh: 希罗娜『在来彩虹百货的这条路上{NEWLINE}找找的话,{CLEAR}应该能发现什么线索吧？
strings.en: Cynthia: If you search along the road{NEWLINE}to the department store, you should{CLEAR}find some kind of clue.

strings.zh: 彩虹百货的东西种类,{NEWLINE}比关东其他城市多太多了,{CLEAR}能来这里购物真好！
strings.en: The Celadon Department Store has so{NEWLINE}many more kinds of goods than other{CLEAR}Kanto cities. It’s great to shop here!
